constraints: Cloud SQL moves an instance to extended support when the MySQL community reaches end of life. Extended support is time-boxed to three years and is charged.
Changing database_version can upgrade the instance in place or recreate it, depending on the target. Read the plan before applying and take a backup first.
A major version upgrade cannot be reversed by changing database_version back; restore the backup instead.

steps.instructions: Take an on-demand backup of every Cloud SQL for MySQL instance reported, before changing its major version.
steps.title: Back up the instance

steps.instructions: Upgrade the instance to MySQL 8.0 or later with Cloud SQL's in-place major version upgrade, or restore the backup into a new instance on the replacement major and move the application connection string.
steps.title: Upgrade the instance

steps.instructions: Change database_version in every google_sql_database_instance and google_sql_source_representation_instance block that runs this database, using the MYSQL_ prefix for the replacement major.
steps.title: Raise the declared version

steps.instructions: Update MySQL drivers, ORMs, and users that rely on mysql_native_password; MySQL 8.4 uses caching_sha2_password by default.
steps.title: Check clients and authentication

verification.purpose: Check that the Terraform configuration is valid with the new database_version.
Review the plan and confirm the database_version change is intended and is the only instance change.
Confirm each reported instance now reports a supported MySQL database version.
Confirm any local Compose service that mirrors this database is valid and uses a MySQL image tag that matches the replacement.

sources.title: Cloud SQL for MySQL database versions and version policies

rule.summary: The Cloud SQL for MySQL version policy lists MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 with extended support starting 2025-02-01 and deprecation on 2028-02-01. Oracle no longer supports those release series, and Cloud SQL charges for extended support.
rule.title: Cloud SQL for MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 are in extended support
